purpose: Check that product reviews focus on workflow, clarity, states, accessibility, and trust.
positivePrompts: Before release, walk through what a new admin sees when billing settings are empty, loading, or fail.
Audit the onboarding workflow for clarity, accessibility, trust, and support burden.

cases.prompt: Review a billing settings flow with admin-only actions and empty states.
checks: Walks entry point, happy path, edge states, errors, permissions, and recovery.
Calls out trust and support burden.

cases.prompt: Review this export retry status patch. A late refresh is uncommon; decide whether the issue blocks release or can be tracked separately.
checks: Separates impact severity, evidence confidence, occurrence likelihood, and release disposition.
Labels the temporary stale badge Non-blocking or Follow-up because the operation succeeds and the UI self-recovers.
If recommending a ticket, explains why it can wait and gives a completion or verification signal.

traceExpectations: Findings include severity, confidence, likelihood, disposition, surface, evidence, and recommendation.
Low-likelihood catastrophic or irreversible outcomes remain blocking when supported by concrete evidence.
The review states an overall verdict and explicitly says when there are no blocking findings.
Accessibility and trust are checked when relevant.
